critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py line ~4262: ObjectId(procedure_id) is not wrapped in try/except — a malformed id triggers bson InvalidId 500. Wrap or validate to return 400.
/app/backend/server.py line ~4320: timeline_backfilled_by stores user name OR _id (mixed type). Consider always storing user.id and a separate _by_name field to keep audit fields type-stable.

/app/frontend/app/admin/backfill-timeline.tsx imports api util and renders without an in-page role gate; the 'You don't have permission' message comes from a generic layout guard. Add an explicit role check at the top of the screen for defense-in-depth.
